newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker RGI buys three trawlers.
newsitem.headline: Aker RGI buys three trawlers.

text.p: Norwegian holding company Aker RGI ASA said on Tuesday it had bought three factory trawlers from Norwegian group Emerald Resource Management for $62 million.
The vessels have been chartered by Norway Seafoods ASA, of which Aker RGI is the major shareholder with 60.7 percent interest.
The Sea Saga and Heather Sea are surimi trawlers with capacities of 160 tonnes per day and 125 tonnes per day respectively, Aker RGI said in a statement.
The Claymore Sea is a filleting trawler with a production capacity of 90 tonnes per day.

The three vessels have cbeen fishing pollock off east Russia through a joint venture with Vladivostok-based Dalmore Product. Aker RGI said the acquisition was made in order to continue the cooperation with Dalmore.
